entries.source:
Prodigies are special talents that only the most powerful of characters can attain.
All of them require at least 50 in a core stat and many also have more special demands. You can learn a new prodigy at level 25 and 42.
entries.target:
觉醒技是角色足够强大时才能获得的特殊技能。
所有觉醒技都要求某项核心属性达到 50 点，其中许多还有更特殊的额外要求。你可以在人物等级达到 25 级和 42 级时各获得一个觉醒技能点。

entries.source: You can learn %d new slot(s). Do you wish to buy one with one category point?
entries.target: 你可以解锁 %d 个新的刻印位。要消耗 1 个技能树解锁点解锁 1 个刻印位吗？

entries.source: You can still learn %d new slot(s) but you need a category point.
entries.target: 你还可以解锁 %d 个新的刻印位，但你需要 1 个技能树解锁点。

entries.source:
A talent category contains talents you may learn. You gain a talent category point at level 10, 20 and 34. You may also find trainers or artifacts that allow you to learn more.
A talent category point can be used either to learn a new category or increase the mastery of a known one.
entries.target:
一个技能树包含你可以学习的技能。你会在 10、20 和 34 级时各获得一个技能树解锁点，也可以找到训练师或神器来学习更多。
每一点技能树解锁点可以用来学习一个新的技能树，或者提升一个已知技能树的掌握度（每点 +0.2）。
